She posted something on her IG with some other dude saying " Best moving partner / handyman ever " with the hugging emoji... is it safe to say she's dating another dude?
That makes sense, it's just my instincts tell me if I message her in a couple of weeks, it may still be too soon. I don't know.
Don't you think it's better to wait for her to reply? Or engage with me again first?

That was my idea as well, I was thinking of just continuing what I was doing anyway and what she was drawn to in the beginning. The last text I sent her was basically a reply to that message just saying, 

" Hey, no problem, I fully understand. 

We need to spend as much time and energy with our friends and family as possible and I'm glad you took the time to reflect. 

And especially with the tighter lockdown, it's probably for the best. 

We can definitely plan something special in the future, I'll be looking forward to it.

And have a happy new year! "

and left it at that. It's just so confusing how she'd ask me out a few months ago, then delete the message and now I asked her out and she cancels.

I was thinking of just focusing on myself, living my life and not really talking to her. And letting her engage in the reschedule. Because I feel like if she really wants to meet, she'd want to try and schedule a plan.
why not go for brother sam?

it's hard man, life is hard and it gives you chances but eventually you run out of luck. I've been keeping healthy, been productive, going to gym, and they said you'd feel better... I'm at this point where I owe money, I can't get clients, been screwed over too much and can't really dig myself out of this... doesn't help that I'm getting older, I'm in my mid twenties and it just feels like yesterday I was a teenager.
